body:
Independent review by mac-claude (fresh reviewer, no other agent consulted), at head 07df48e2094ea82e14bf8537d1320f10b6af6ecd.

**Verdict: approve, no findings.**

Checked against the repository, not taken from the description:
- The diff is the one regex change in `reference_integrity_pre_pass` (`scripts/cold-read-grid.py:277-279`) plus one new test case in `scripts/cold-read-grid-test.py`. The path alternative is unchanged.
- Blast radius: I re-ran old vs new regex over all 146 tracked `.md` files at the head. The only candidates that differ are `CLAUDE.local.md` (was `local.md`, 14 files) and `settings.local.json` (was `local.json`, 1 file), as the PR says.
- Edge inputs traced by hand and by running the regex: trailing punctuation (`CLAUDE.local.md.`, `x.md,`) is still excluded; `README.md.bak` and `foo.mdx` extract as before (`README.md`, `foo.md`); `e.g. foo.md` still gives `foo.md`; `.claude.json` still loses its leading dot, as the PR states.
- Backtracking cost: `(?:\.[\w-]+)*` is quadratic in the length of one dotted run with no extension (a synthetic 40 KB `a.a.a...` run took about 9 s). Real documents have short dotted runs: the whole 146-file tree scans in about 0.5 s. Not a finding.
- `scripts/cold-read-grid-test.py` at the head: `all cases passed`, including the three new checks.

Not run: the full sweep (`run-all-test-suites.py`); I ran only the suite this change touches. I did not reproduce the RED run.

Review by merge-lane-2 (ned-box). Two readers besides this seat: an independent fresh `mac-claude` reviewer (review 5286260878, APPROVE, 0 findings) and this seat's own review subagent, which also ran Codex's built-in review (`scripts/code-review-codex-cell.py`). Codex reported "No actionable defects were found."

**Classification:** code only (`scripts/cold-read-grid.py` and its test).

**Verified against the repository, not taken from the description:**
- **Blast radius:** re-run by this seat. Across every tracked `.md` file, the old and new regex differ on two names only: `local.md` becomes `CLAUDE.local.md` (14 files) and `local.json` becomes `settings.local.json` (1 file). This matches the description.
- **Change is needed:** the head's test file, run against the base `8146fc0c` script, exits 1 with 2 failures ("a bare file name with two dots resolves with its whole name", "and no truncated name is listed"). At the head it exits 0 (129 PASS).
- **Tests can fail:** changing `(?:\.[\w-]+)*` to `+` fails "a bare file name with one dot still resolves".
- **Full sweep at the head:** 70 passed, 0 failed, with 2 macOS-only skips.
- **The user's ruling:** found in his own words in Mac session b1b9e439. Backlog-recheck walk item 1, fix 4 was listed at 17:06:20Z on 2026-09-17, and he answered "approved - if you are sure these are all update to date and correct. Are you?" at 17:18:53Z. His "drop 5" at 17:29:08Z drops a different fix.

**Non-blocking notes:**
- The new alternative backtracks roughly quadratically on a very long dotted run that has no known extension. A made-up 40 KB `a.a.a…` string took about 9 s. The whole tree scans in about 0.5 s, and no document contains such a run.
- A leading-dot bare name (`.claude.json`) still loses its dot, as the description says. That behaviour is unchanged by this PR.

**Overlap:** PR 636 changes the same two files. Whichever merges second may need a rebase.

Approved.
